text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work. Right now, 
I'm offering 
a detailed overview of the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai 
for anyone who'd like one, but――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>, 
would you like an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
All right, what would you like me to 
explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything you'd like to know 
about 
training during preparations for the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About the Goshiki Shuntaisai, then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Goshiki Shuntaisai is a special 
Shuntaisai 
held once every twelve years, in the Year 
of the Horse.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To make this Goshiki Shuntaisai a success, 
everyone will rehearse 5 different 
Programs 
alongside their daily training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, in addition to the main event 
held in late October of Senior Year――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Progress Presentations will be held 
in late December of both Junior and 
Classic Years.
color_text_info_list: Late December of Junior and Classic Years

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To make these a success, the key factors 
are 
each Program's Program Lv and Program 
Completion!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
During the Goshiki Shuntaisai rehearsal 
period, 
conducting Program Rehearsals will raise 
each Program's Program Lv.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Program Completion rises when you raise 
Program Lvs 
and reach the target levels set for each 
Progress Presentation and the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.
color_text_info_list: For each Presentation and the Shuntaisai,
reaches the target level and increases.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Carry out plenty of Program Rehearsals, 
raise those Program Lvs, 
and ensure both the Presentations and the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai are huge hits!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, this time, you will be advancing 
preparations 
for the Goshiki Shuntaisai while 
simultaneously 
participating in the Twinkle Series.
color_text_info_list: While participating in the Twinkle Series

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please keep in mind that depending on your 
training progress, 
training may end early even during the 
rehearsal period 
for the Goshiki Shuntaisai, so do be 
careful.
color_text_info_list: even during the Shuntaisai rehearsal period,

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the overview of the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai. 
Is there anything else you would like to 
ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About Program Rehearsal, then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
For this Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
five Programs will be performed: Yabusame, 
Shinbata Scramble, Osame-mai, Oobiki 
Mikoshi, and Soaring Gallop.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Each Program has a corresponding Program 
Gauge... 
Filling this Program Gauge to maximum 
unlocks 
the ability to carry out a Program 
Rehearsal!
color_text_info_list: the ability to do Program Rehearsal!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Program Rehearsals are conducted with the 
Umamusume assigned to that Program, 
granting far greater stat gains to develop 
your Umamusume 
compared to regular training.
color_text_info_list: Program Rehearsals are held with assigned Umamusume

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the training effects scale up 
with Program Lv, 
so we strongly recommend holding Program 
Rehearsals actively.
color_text_info_list: As effects scale up with Program Lv,

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, during the Shuntaisai 
Training Camp starting in early July each 
year, 
you can engage in intensive Program 
Rehearsals 
regardless of the Program Gauge!
color_text_info_list: you can do intensive Program Rehearsals!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that the primary stats gained 
differ depending on the Program Rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Keep in mind that Yabusame gives Speed, 
Shinbata Scramble gives Stamina, 
Osame-mai gives Power, Oobiki Mikoshi 
gives Guts, and Soaring Gallop gives Wit♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, the Umamusume assigned to 
each Program 
are primarily chosen from Support Cards 
and Scenario Link Umamusume.
color_text_info_list: Support Cards and Scenario Link Umamusume

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In particular, Support Card Umamusume are 
assigned 
to Programs based on their card type. 
This is a crucial point, so be sure to 
remember it!
color_text_info_list: Assigned to Programs based on card type.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the overview of Program 
Rehearsal. 
Is there anything else you would like to 
ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About Bestowing Teachings, then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Through rehearsals for the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai, 
the Umamusume assigned to each Program 
will receive 
Teachings that aid in training.
color_text_info_list: The Umamusume assigned to each Program,
receive Teachings that aid in training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There are five initial Teachings available 
to bestow. 
You can assign one of these Teachings 
to each individual Program.
color_text_info_list: Five initial Teachings available to bestow.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, each Teaching provides 
a distinct training effect...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
These effects trigger whenever you train 
alongside 
the Umamusume assigned to that Program♪
color_text_info_list: effects trigger whenever you train alongside them♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When bestowing Teachings, consider which 
Umamusume 
should receive which Teaching... 
Check their effects carefully before 
making your choice!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the overview of Bestowing 
Teachings. 
Is there anything else you would like to 
ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About Transmuting Teachings, then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
While the first Teachings you obtain 
are five basic ones...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
After each Progress Presentation, 
you will gain 2 new Teachings in Junior 
Year, 
and 3 new Teachings in Classic Year.
color_text_info_list: 2 in Junior Year, 3 in Classic Year,

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And the rite of combining these new 
Teachings 
with your original Teachings 
is known as "Transmuting Teachings."
color_text_info_list: the rite of combining initial Teachings

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When Transmuting Teachings, each time you 
acquire a new Teaching, 
you select 1 of the initial 5 Teachings 
to fuse together with the new one.
color_text_info_list: Each time a new Teaching is gained,
and combine it with the new Teaching.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Doing so grants the new Teaching 
a unique Transmuted Effect depending on 
which Teaching was chosen!
color_text_info_list: A unique Transmuted Effect based on selection

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that once a Teaching has been 
used for transmutation, 
it cannot be used for transmutation a 
second time.
color_text_info_list: cannot be used for transmutation again.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Transmuted Effects all provide 
powerful training benefits, 
so be sure to take full advantage of them.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Like standard Teaching effects, Transmuted 
Effects 
activate when you train alongside the 
Umamusume 
assigned to that Program.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understand the effects of each, 
and use them to advance your training with 
an edge!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation 
regarding 'Teaching Transmutation.' 
Do you have any other questions?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you're all set?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. ♪ Just in case, I have 
a brief summary prepared right here for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review what we just covered at any 
time 
by tapping the 'i Button' in the top-left 
corner.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Best of luck to you, then. 
I'll be cheering you on from the 
sidelines.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best out 
there! 
I'll be cheering you on from the 
sidelines.
